title: Aarya
desc: Arya, a free-spirited guy, relentlessly tries to woo Geethanjali, the girlfriend of a college rowdy, Ajay. However, when the couple faces trouble, Arya steps in to help them.

title: Junga
desc: Junga, a simple bus conductor, lives with his mother and learns that his father lost their ancestral property to Chettiyar. However, he soon turns to the life of crime to retrieve it.

title: Paruthiveeran
desc: A young, carefree man, Paruthiveeran, saves Muththazhagu's life, and they eventually fall in love. However, their families object to their union, forcing the couple to elope together.

title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.

title: Kathakali
desc: Amudhavel, a simpleton, gets embroiled in the murder of Thamba, a local gangster. The police think that he is the culprit as he had a conflict with him in the past.
